name: CDF Normalization via Normal Distribution Approximation
aliases: Normal Distribution Approximation for Perlin Noise
definition: A method to compensate for mean shift by approximating Perlin noise as a normal distribution, transforming it to a uniform distribution via CDF, applying a function, and normalizing by the integral of that function.
summary: This method compensates for mean shifts in Perlin noise by approximating its distribution as normal, mapping values to uniform via the CDF, applying transformations, and normalizing the result.
